steps.heading: Choose a tool
steps.body: Search for a task or filter the directory by category to open the matching workflow.

steps.heading: Add your source
steps.body: Select a file or complete the inputs shown for that tool. Review its available options before running it.

steps.heading: Review the result
steps.body: Check the result details and download the generated file from the result panel.

steps.heading: Upload a scanned PDF
steps.body: Select a scanned PDF in the upload area; supported size limits are shown beside it.

steps.heading: After upload, select an available OCR language
steps.body: After selecting the file, choose a language from the available control before recognition; no quality setting is shown.

steps.heading: Download the searchable PDF
steps.body: Download the searchable copy and check several pages for recognition quality.

steps.heading: Upload a text-based or OCR PDF
steps.body: Select a text PDF or an OCR-processed scan in the upload area above.

steps.heading: Choose the target language in the visible selector
steps.body: The target-language selector is available before upload; choose a language before starting the translation.

steps.heading: Review and download the translated copy
steps.body: Review the translated pages and text layer before sharing the output.

steps.heading: Enter an allowed public URL
steps.body: Enter a public web address in the URL field above; private network destinations are blocked.

steps.heading: Review the URL and start the conversion
steps.body: Check the URL you entered, then run the conversion. This form does not offer separate page-size controls.

steps.heading: Download the rendered PDF
steps.body: Open the generated PDF and review its page breaks, fonts, and images.

steps.heading: Select JPG or other supported images
steps.body: The upload area above lists the supported file types and limits for this tool.

steps.heading: Upload them in the order you want in the PDF
steps.body: Use only the controls shown in the workspace; file-dependent options appear after selection when needed.

steps.heading: Download the generated PDF
steps.body: Review the result details, then download and open the output to check it.

download_view.heading: Choose a platform
download_view.body: Select the desktop or mobile platform you want updates about.

download_view.heading: Enter your email
download_view.body: Provide an address where Paperplane can send app availability updates.

download_view.heading: Join the waitlist
download_view.body: Submit the form to register interest. No app installer is available to download yet.
